articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: CrowdStrike and federal authorities dismantle Russian malware that secretly stole crypto for 8 years
articles.snippet: Russia-based Sality watched for copied bitcoin and Ethereum addresses and quietly replaced them with the attacker’s. CrowdStrike and law enforcement have now isolated more than 15,000 infected machines.

articles.title: XRP ETFs pull in $170 million over 11 days. Goldman tops institutional holders
articles.snippet: Spot XRP funds have logged 11 straight sessions of inflows, while Q2 filings show Goldman Sachs, Jane Street and Millennium among their biggest professional holders.

articles.title: OpenAI says its new 'Astra' AI can build attacks without human help
articles.snippet: Astra is the first OpenAI model to reach its “Critical” cybersecurity threshold, meaning it can find previously unknown vulnerabilities and develop ways to exploit them across hardened systems.

articles.title: Bitcoin withstands $90 oil and rising yields while gold slides. A firm dollar is the catch
articles.snippet: BTC trades choppy as $90 oil and rising bond yields weigh on stocks and gold.
